extra.message: Hardcoded Secret Key Enables Session Hijacking and CSRF Bypass — Attacker can forge session tokens for any user, leading to account takeover. Can also forge CSRF tokens to bypass CSRF protection on mutating endpoints, enabling cross-origin attacks. [verified: The default secret key 'local-dev-secret-change-me' is used when APP_SECRET_KEY env var is unset; this key is publicly known and used by hash_token() to sign session and CSRF tokens, enabling forgery without any compensating validation.]
